## What's new

This stable release rolls up dev pre-release v3.07-dev.

It contains **no application code changes** — nothing about how the system
behaves, looks or performs is different from v3.06. Installations can take it at
their convenience.

### Changed

- **Releases to the stable channel now happen only when the maintainer asks for
  them.** Development work continues to land on the dev channel as it always
  has, but a stable release — the one production installations receive — is no
  longer cut automatically alongside it. The two channels are expected to sit
  apart, often by several releases, so that changes can be exercised on dev
  before they reach production.

This is a change to the project's own release process, recorded in the
repository so it applies consistently. It is included here so the stable branch
carries the same guidance as the development branch.
